notes.title: Typo and Grammar Error Fix [Dec 2017]
notes.content:
After hearing some feedback regarding typo and grammar error from community, Sekai Project QA team has done massive proofread on VOID. The revision has been integrated and hopefully cover all past errors.

Cheers!

notes.title: Typos and Total Play Time
notes.content:
After hearing some feedback from those who have bought VOID, we are now in progress to correct all typo and grammar error. We have done QA beforehand, so we didn't really expect this problem after release.

Regarding the information about the length of VOID, we have checked it again with adjusted reading speed, and we found that it should be about 13 hours max if you read with auto play.

We want to apologize about these issues, and we hope you can still enjoy it!

notes.title: VOID Has Been Released - Trading Cards Pending
notes.content:
Hi, Dev team here,
After long delay and multiple changes in art style, VOID now is available for you to purchase. We hope it can satisfy your expectation regarding the premises it offers.

As a side note, badge and trading cards update will need to wait for several hours, as we need to re-upload some assets, and wait for Steam reviewer to confirm them.

Happy reading~
